setting_verbatim_quote: Top-level README title: 'RepQ-ViT: Scale Reparameterization for Post-Training Quantization of Vision Transformers' -- 'decouples the quantization and inference processes and applies scale reparameterization to solve the extreme distribution issues in vision transformers'. classification/README.md results-table caption: 'Below are the experimental results of our proposed RepQ-ViT that you should get on ImageNet dataset.' Columns are bit-width configs (W4/A4, W6/A6), not training epochs/schedule -- a post-training (no retraining/fine-tuning) method applied to an off-the-shelf pretrained checkpoint, exactly matching what our harness runs (test_quant.py has no training loop). Applies to every reference in this file -- no per-config setting variation exists for a pure-PTQ method (unlike B1's ToMe, which has both off-the-shelf and trained-with-method DeiT numbers).
